source_lines.54: [F2] *Combing.* Assume $n\ge2$ and let $W$ be a word in $\sigma_1^{\pm1},\dots,\sigma_{n-1}^{\pm1}$ whose image under $\varphi_n$ is the trivial geometric braid. Then $W$ is equivalent, by the permitted moves of [F1], to a product $W_1W_2$ in which $W_1$ is a word in $x_1^{\pm1},\dots,x_{n-1}^{\pm1}$ and $W_2$ is a word in $\sigma_1^{\pm1},\dots,\sigma_{n-2}^{\pm1}$, where $x_j=\alpha_{j+1}^{-1}\sigma_j^{2}\alpha_{j+1}$ are the combing words of [[def-zariski-braid-combing-words-alpha-and-x]] ([[lem-every-trivial-braid-word-combs-as-w-one-w-two]]).
